title: How to Know a Person
description: NEW YORK TIMES BESTSELLER • A practical, heartfelt guide to the art of truly knowing another person in order to foster deeper connections at home, at work, and throughout our lives - from the author of The Road to Character and The Second Mountain More than a guide to better conversations, it’s a blueprint for a more connected and humane way of living.
